Interface Metrics

All Known Implementing Classes:
MetricsImpl
public interface Metrics
Client interface for the Equinix Fabric Metrics API. Provides a filtered search over time-series metrics for Fabric assets (connections, ports, and more), superseding the deprecated per-asset /stats statistics endpoints.
Author:
ianjones

    • getMetricsByName

      List<Metric> getMetricsByName(String name, String value)
      Retrieves metrics by wildcard metric name (GET /fabric/v4/metrics). Only the wildcard metro metric types are supported (for example equinix.fabric.metro.*.latency or equinix.fabric.metro.*.jitter_avg). This endpoint does not support time-range filtering.
      Parameters:
      name - the wildcard metric name (required)
      value - which value to retrieve (for example last; required)
      Returns:
      the list of matching metrics

    • getMetricsByAssetId

      List<Metric> getMetricsByAssetId(String asset, String assetId, String name, LocalDateTime fromDateTime, LocalDateTime toDateTime)
      Retrieves metrics for a specific asset (GET /fabric/v4/{asset}/{assetId}/metrics).

      UTC contract: LocalDateTime inputs are UTC wall clock (matching every timestamp the SDK returns); use LocalDateTime.now(ZoneOffset.UTC) for the current time.

      Parameters:
      asset - the asset type, one of ports, connections, or metros
      assetId - the asset uuid
      name - the metric name to retrieve (for example equinix.fabric.port.bandwidth_rx.usage)
      fromDateTime - the start of the metrics time range as UTC wall clock, or null
      toDateTime - the end of the metrics time range as UTC wall clock, or null
      Returns:
      the list of matching metrics for the asset
